update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.40 - Smart Race Solver training respect + generation-farm nav enforcement
Additions --- - New "Respect solver training calls" toggle in Parent Farming Settings: when on, skips the fan-farming interval race fallback whenever the Smart Race Solver recommends training instead, trading fan progress for more consistent spark training (default off) - Generation farm's career-selection gate now actively auto-navigates (home -> Career hub -> trainee -> scenario) instead of only logging a reminder, including before the very first generation of a breeding plan
